# package cemi

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/cemi"
```

Package cemi encodes and decodes frames of the common External Message Interface (cEMI): the data link layer messages (L\_Data, L\_Busmon, L\_Raw) that KNXnet/IP tunnelling and routing carry, and the local device management messages (M\_PropRead, M\_PropWrite, M\_Reset, function properties) of KNXnet/IP device management.

The transport and application layers inside an L\_Data frame (TPCI, APCI) are kept as octets here; package apdu decodes them.

Additional information types used by this package.

```go
const (
	// Ctrl1Standard is the frame type bit: set for a standard frame,
	// clear for an extended frame.
	Ctrl1Standard byte = 0x80
	// Ctrl1NoRepeat set means "do not repeat on error".
	Ctrl1NoRepeat byte = 0x20
	// Ctrl1Broadcast set means a normal broadcast, clear a system
	// broadcast.
	Ctrl1Broadcast byte = 0x10
	// Ctrl1AckRequest asks for a layer-2 acknowledgement.
	Ctrl1AckRequest byte = 0x02
	// Ctrl1ConfirmError marks an L_Data.con that reports an error.
	Ctrl1ConfirmError byte = 0x01
)
```

Control field 1 bits.

```go
const (
	DefaultCtrl1 = Ctrl1Standard | Ctrl1NoRepeat | Ctrl1Broadcast | byte(knx.PriorityLow)<<2
	DefaultCtrl2 = Ctrl2GroupAddress | 6<<4
)
```

Default control fields: a standard frame, not repeated, broadcast, low priority; a group destination with hop count 6. These are the fields KNXnet/IP clients usually send in an L\_Data.req.

```go
const (
	// Ctrl2GroupAddress marks a group destination address.
	Ctrl2GroupAddress byte = 0x80
)
```

Control field 2 bits.

```go
const MaxStandardNPDU = 15
```

MaxStandardNPDU is the longest NPDU (TPDU length minus one) of a standard frame; longer TPDUs need an extended frame.

## Functions

### func Marshal

```go
func Marshal(f Frame) ([]byte, error)
```

Marshal returns the encoded frame.

### func TP1Frame

```go
func TP1Frame(f *LData) ([]byte, error)
```

TP1Frame returns the KNX TP1 standard data frame of an L\_Data frame, as carried in an L\_Busmon.ind: control field, source, destination, address type / hop count / length octet, TPDU and check octet. Only standard frames (NPDU of at most 15 octets) have this format.

The repeat flag of the control field (bit 5 clear: a repetition) is taken from an L\_Data.ind that reports a repeated frame, as [ParseTP1](#func-parsetp1) decodes one; a frame of any other message code is a first transmission.

### type LData

```go
type LData struct {
	MsgCode MessageCode
	AddInfo []AdditionalInfo
	Ctrl1   byte
	Ctrl2   byte
	Source  knx.IndividualAddress
	// Destination is a group address when Ctrl2GroupAddress is set,
	// otherwise an individual address. Use [LData.Group] and
	// [LData.Individual].
	Destination uint16
	// TPDU is the transport protocol data unit: the TPCI octet, the APCI
	// and the data (package apdu).
	TPDU []byte
}
```

LData is an L\_Data.req, L\_Data.ind or L\_Data.con frame. The control fields are kept as sent; the accessors interpret them.

#### func NewGroupFrame

```go
func NewGroupFrame(code MessageCode, src knx.IndividualAddress, dst knx.GroupAddress, p knx.Priority, tpdu []byte) *LData
```

NewGroupFrame returns an L\_Data frame of code to group address dst with the default control fields and priority p.

#### func ParseTP1

```go
func ParseTP1(b []byte) (*LData, error)
```

ParseTP1 decodes a TP1 standard data frame (as in an L\_Busmon.ind) into an L\_Data.ind. It checks the frame type, the length and the check octet.
